thesis.infer: Flat price with steady OI and funding at the floor reads as a market holding a level without new leverage, so there is little to squeeze and little to unwind. Contracting stablecoin supply, a Restrictive Macro lens and a risk-off label disagree with the rising weekly structure and a Neutral Compass. Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read persistent oil strength near $110 as keeping the hawkish side of that meeting live.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC chops between the True Market Mean ($79.2K) and the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close above $81.7K with OI recovering would soften the risk-off read, while a daily close below it is hl-cycles' stated invalidation and keeps the risk-off label. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below $79.2K could put the STH cost basis ($74.4K, about 9% below) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a hold with dovish language and oil below $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and BTC extend higher. Consensus is pricing a hold; we read the risk as skewing to a hawkish surprise.
